d:
Moeen Ali, Sam Billings and Andre Russell bring the fireworks as Arabian Aces chase down 104 in just 8.5 overs to seal a commanding 7-wicket victory!
After Iftikhar Ahmed's fighting 46 off 24 balls powered United Tigers to 103/5, the Aces came out all guns blazing. Moeen smashed 34 off 17, Sam Billings hammered 31 off just 11, and Andre Russell provided the finishing flourish with an unbeaten 22 off 9 balls.
Watch 2026 | 7th NOV to 20th NOV on Star Sports & JioHotstar.
